Need to discuss this topic with Christian Krausse
The fuses blew while the system was in boost mode, delivering 400A, which exceeds the 250A rating of the fuses. we can suggest the replacement of fuses, but it’s likely that the new fuses will also blow again under the same conditions. How can we prevent this from happening?
